Friends Feature End-to-End Flow (migration to UI)
Offline Sync Write Path (optimistic to drained)

nodes.label: TODO: Integrate with error tracking service
nodes.norm_label: todo: integrate with error tracking service

nodes.label: Errand Session (GrocerySession)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately no 'paused' status — 'Resume Later' simply leaves the session active, keeping the state machine at active|completed plus cancel-by-delete. Gains name, store_id and updated_at (needed for sync LWW anyway).

nodes.label: product_catalog (extended)
nodes.rationale: Gains brand, barcode, package_size, image_path, notes and is_favorite while keeping existing default_quantity/default_unit/lifespan_days/purchase_count/last_purchased_at used by suggestions.

nodes.label: product_stores Join Table
nodes.rationale: Holds per-store price, aisle, availability and sku with a unique (product_id, store_id); this is what makes future price-comparison and auto aisle grouping possible without another migration.

nodes.label: stores Table
nodes.rationale: Backfilled from distinct grocery_sessions.store_name; store_name text is kept on sessions during the transition while a nullable store_id FK is added, so no big-bang cutover is required.

nodes.label: SessionBanner Status Caption
nodes.rationale: The green progress bar is replaced by a one-line caption '{done} of {total} · ₱{spend} so far' in inkSoft, removing the second accent color while keeping the same information.

nodes.label: Deferred Grocery Non-Goals
nodes.rationale: Barcode hardware, voice input, spending analytics, import/export, price comparison and auto aisle grouping are explicitly out of scope now, but the schema (barcode, product_stores, history) is designed so they need no future migration.

nodes.label: Lists Become Pure Templates
nodes.rationale: Checking and purchasing move exclusively into errand sessions; is_checked/checked_by/checked_at fall out of use and the sync_grocery_item_on_session_purchase trigger is removed. Tables are kept rather than dropped so web and collaboration FKs do not break.

nodes.label: Price Feedback Policy on Session Complete
nodes.norm_label: price feedback policy on session complete
nodes.rationale: On completion, catalog-linked items upsert their last price_paid and aisle back into product_stores. Temporary items with no product_id must never touch the catalog — an explicit spec requirement to keep one-off purchases out of the permanent catalog.

nodes.label: Hybrid Local/Remote Offline-First Strategy
nodes.rationale: Notes deliberately diverge from React Query: LocalNotesStorage plus NoteSyncService give offline-first editing with dirty-state tracking and conflict resolution, which a pure cache-based fetcher cannot provide.

nodes.label: React Query Data Fetching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Storage and Cards modules use TanStack Query v5 with staleTime 5min / gcTime 10min; React 19 requires dedupe of react and react-dom in Vite to avoid duplicate React instances.

nodes.label: Adding a New Module Recipe
nodes.rationale: Four-step recipe: shared domain+infrastructure, package.json subpath export, web presentation + alias registration in three config files, mobile presentation + alias in tsconfig and Metro.

nodes.label: Web Path Alias @core Gotcha
nodes.rationale: The directory is src/modules/shared but the alias is named @core, not @shared — a naming mismatch that must be replicated in vite.config.ts, tsconfig.app.json and vitest.config.ts. Mobile deliberately uses only @/* -> ./src/*.

nodes.label: Mobile Dashboard Quick-Links Grid
nodes.rationale: Mirrors web's quickLinks array as a 2-column FlatList; Storage is skipped because it is enterprise-gated on web. @expo/vector-icons Feather substitutes for web's Lucide icons.

nodes.label: CategoryGroup #tag Headers
nodes.rationale: Gray pill headers become flush-left cyan #tags with a chevron and no background fill; isCollapsed state and collapseStamp behaviour stay untouched so this is purely visual.

nodes.label: Passwords CategoryChips
nodes.rationale: Copied from cards/CategoryChips with CardCategoryType swapped for CategoryType; All / Favorites / per-category (long-press to edit) / +Add dashed chip.

nodes.label: Mobile Cards Module Plan
nodes.rationale: Reimplements web's sidebar+grid cards UI with mobile-native affordances while reusing shared repositories and entities unchanged.

nodes.label: Mobile Passwords Module Plan
nodes.rationale: Ports the web PasswordsPage to mobile by copying the cards module structure verbatim, because cards already solved bottom-sheet, form-keyboard and category-chip patterns on React Native.

nodes.label: FriendPicker Component
nodes.rationale: Renders nothing when no eligible friends remain, filters out excludeUserIds (existing members), and delegates entirely to the caller's onPick — so it adds no share plumbing and no new RLS.

nodes.label: AddShopperModal (session membership flow)
nodes.rationale: Existing flow: email -> get_user_id_by_email RPC -> direct grocery_session_members insert. Unlike lists, there is no acceptance step for shoppers.

nodes.label: ShareListModal (list invitation flow)
nodes.rationale: Existing flow: email -> grocery_invitations row -> invitee accepts -> grocery_list_members. Friend picker sits above the email field and reuses the same onInvite(email) path.

nodes.label: Web-to-RN Grocery Component Mapping
nodes.rationale: 15 web components map one-to-one to RN equivalents; Dialog becomes Modal, CSS width% progress becomes a nested View with an inline width style, and web context menus become long-press bottom modals (cross-platform, simpler than ActionSheetIOS).

nodes.label: RN Slide-Up Modal Pattern
nodes.rationale: Modal animationType=slide transparent, with a Pressable black/40 backdrop above a rounded-t-2xl sheet — one shape reused by every grocery modal.

nodes.label: AddItemInput Reskin
nodes.rationale: surface fill, hairline border, radius 2, cyan + glyph, italic inkSoft placeholder; suggestion rows lose the indigo highlight in favour of a faint surface fill.

nodes.label: Friendship as Discovery Layer Only
nodes.rationale: Friendship grants zero list or errand access — a friend tap just calls the existing onInvite(email)/onAddShopper(email) flows. This keeps risk low and requires no changes to existing grocery RLS or membership logic. Consequence: unfriending does not revoke already-granted memberships.

nodes.label: Note Entity
nodes.rationale: Business logic lives in the entity class rather than in hooks or components so it stays framework-free and unit testable.

nodes.label: Passwords Module (client-side AES-GCM)
nodes.rationale: Encryption happens client-side via Web Crypto API with PBKDF2 key derivation from the user ID, so the server never holds plaintext credentials.

nodes.label: Notes Module Known Limitations
nodes.rationale: At time of writing: hardcoded mock user ID pending auth integration, no pagination (acceptable for personal-scale usage), page reload on clearing search, no offline support and no real-time sync across devices.

nodes.label: Planned Offline Support Enhancement
nodes.rationale: Listed as a potential enhancement (offline support with local storage, real-time via Supabase subscriptions) that the later HybridNoteRepository/NoteSyncService design fulfils.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern For Data Access (spec)
nodes.rationale: Hooks depend on repository classes with a private mapToEntity step, isolating Supabase row shapes from domain entities so the backend can change without touching presentation.

nodes.label: Dependency Rule (inward only)
nodes.rationale: Presentation depends on Infrastructure which depends on Domain, never the reverse, keeping business rules independent of React and of the data source.

nodes.label: Framework Agnostic Domain Layer
nodes.rationale: Domain has no React or UI dependencies, which is what later allowed domain plus infrastructure to be lifted into the shared package for mobile reuse.

nodes.label: Dependency Inversion (domain defines interfaces)
nodes.rationale: Repository interfaces are declared in the domain layer and implemented in infrastructure, so swapping Supabase for another backend does not touch domain or presentation.

nodes.label: friendlyError Postgres Exception Mapper
nodes.rationale: Substring-matches raised Postgres exception codes onto user-facing sentences, keeping error copy in the repository instead of the UI.

nodes.label: FriendRepository
nodes.rationale: cancelRequest and remove issue the identical DELETE but are kept as distinct method names for caller clarity; accept/decline update status and rely on the addressee-only UPDATE policy for authorization rather than re-checking in code.

nodes.label: friendships Table Migration
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE (requester_id, addressee_id) plus CHECK (requester_id <> addressee_id) enforce at the DB level what the RPC also checks; indexes on both id columns because queries run in both directions.

nodes.label: get_friend_requests RPC
nodes.rationale: Returns pending rows in both directions; the client derives incoming vs outgoing from mapFriendRow rather than the server splitting them.

nodes.label: get_friends RPC
nodes.rationale: Returns accepted rows joined twice against auth.users so both emails come back in one query, avoiding per-row email lookups on the client.

nodes.label: mapFriendRow (pure row mapper)
nodes.rationale: Pure function computing the friend's identity and direction relative to currentUserId; isolating this makes the domain testable via Vitest with no Supabase involved.

nodes.label: send_friend_request RPC
nodes.rationale: Raises USER_NOT_FOUND, CANNOT_FRIEND_SELF, ALREADY_FRIENDS or REQUEST_ALREADY_PENDING. A previously declined row is revived by rewriting requester/addressee and resetting status to pending, so a re-send after a decline is allowed without violating the unique constraint.

nodes.label: FriendType (other-party-relative shape)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately stores the OTHER person's userId and email plus a direction marker, so the UI never has to branch on whether the current user was requester or addressee.

nodes.label: Mutual Friend Graph (request + accept)
nodes.rationale: Requester sends, addressee accepts; 'my friends' are accepted rows where auth.uid() is on either side. Mutual consent chosen so nobody can unilaterally attach themselves to another user.

nodes.label: MobileAuthRepository
nodes.rationale: Implements the shared AuthRepository interface directly; every method is platform-agnostic Supabase except signInWithGoogle. Web is untouched — mobile gets its own implementation rather than branching the shared one.

nodes.label: useLogin Hook
nodes.rationale: Owns loading and error state so the login screen can drop its local stubs; routes to /(app)/dashboard via router.replace on success.

nodes.label: Row-Level Security via auth.uid()
nodes.rationale: RLS is enabled on every table and every policy is scoped through auth.uid(), so data isolation is enforced at the database rather than in client code.

nodes.label: Supabase init/get Singleton Dependency Injection
nodes.rationale: Each platform calls initSupabase once at startup with its own env vars and auth storage; every repository calls getSupabase(). Keeps the shared package free of platform env assumptions. Same init/get pattern applies to Logger.

nodes.label: friendships RLS Policy Matrix
nodes.rationale: SELECT and DELETE allow either party; INSERT requires requester_id = auth.uid(); UPDATE is restricted to addressee_id = auth.uid() so a requester can never self-accept their own request.

nodes.label: SECURITY DEFINER RPCs over Raw Client Queries
nodes.norm_label: security definer rpcs over raw client queries
nodes.rationale: Three reasons: keep other users' emails private by preventing direct auth.users reads, dedupe a request across both directions atomically, and resolve user_id to email server-side to avoid N+1 lookups.

nodes.label: Native Google Sign-In via ID Token
nodes.norm_label: native google sign-in via id token
nodes.rationale: @react-native-google-signin/google-signin plus supabase.auth.signInWithIdToken gives Google's own native sign-in sheet instead of a webview flow; requires expo prebuild and an Expo config plugin.

nodes.label: initSupabase authStorage Extension
nodes.rationale: An optional authStorage param is the only shared-package change: it spreads into the auth options only when provided, so web (which passes nothing) is byte-for-byte unchanged. Risk assessed as near zero.

nodes.label: useFriends Hook
nodes.rationale: Two React Query queries plus five mutations that all funnel through one invalidate(); incoming/outgoing are derived client-side by filtering on direction. Placed under the grocery hooks dir even though the domain module is standalone.

nodes.label: useCards Hook
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the grocery hook pattern: React Query over CreditCardRepository, Alert.alert on error, getLogger(), and filter stabilization via useMemo on individual filter properties (borrowed from web). Skips useSubscription checks since mobile has no subscription gating yet.

nodes.label: Expo Router File-Based Routing
nodes.rationale: Route groups: (auth) public, (app) protected. experiments.typedRoutes makes routes type-checked. Deep link scheme himan://.

nodes.label: Mobile AuthProvider / useAuth
nodes.rationale: Subscribes to onAuthStateChange and seeds from getSession; deliberately omits the web version's URL-hash parsing, which has no meaning on native.

nodes.label: ExpoSecureStoreAdapter
nodes.rationale: Three-method adapter mapping getItem/setItem/removeItem onto expo-secure-store, so Supabase persists the session in the device keychain instead of localStorage.

nodes.label: Auth-Driven Route Restructure
nodes.rationale: Splits routes into (auth) and (app) groups so auth state, not button handlers, controls navigation; index.tsx redirects based on the resolved user.

nodes.label: Grocery Hooks Port (web to mobile)
nodes.rationale: Seven hooks ported with four mechanical substitutions: useAuth import path, Logger to getLogger, toast.error to Alert.alert, and repository imports pointed at @himan/shared/grocery. queryKeys.ts is copied verbatim so cache keys stay identical across platforms.

nodes.label: usePasswordCategories Hook
nodes.rationale: deleteCategory must also invalidate passwordsKeys.passwords() because passwords hold a dangling category reference after their category is removed.

nodes.label: usePasswords Hook
nodes.rationale: Mirrors useCards: useQuery over PasswordRepository.findAll(filters, userId), mutations for create/update/delete/toggleFavorite, all invalidating passwordsKeys.passwords(), errors via Alert.alert plus getLogger().error().

nodes.label: Protected Route Guard Pattern
nodes.rationale: app/(app)/_layout.tsx returns null while loading and redirects to /(auth)/login when there is no user — guarding at the group layout rather than per screen.

nodes.label: QueryClientProvider Placement Decision
nodes.rationale: Placed in app/(app)/_layout.tsx (the protected layout) rather than the root layout, so grocery screens share one cache while auth screens, which need no query cache, stay outside it.

nodes.label: Two-Route Grocery Navigation
nodes.rationale: Separate grocery.tsx, grocery/[listId].tsx and grocery/session.tsx routes are more idiomatic on mobile than the web's single-screen mobileView toggle.

nodes.label: (app) Route Group over (tabs)
nodes.rationale: A tab bar is unnecessary with a single destination; a plain group keeps authenticated screens organized and converts to tabs later without restructuring.

nodes.label: CardFormScreen
nodes.rationale: One reusable full-screen form serving both cards/add.tsx and cards/[cardId].tsx; selects render as chips or a modal picker rather than adding a third-party picker dependency.

nodes.label: Luhn Card Number Validation
nodes.rationale: Copied verbatim from web CardDialog.tsx so validation behaviour stays identical across platforms.

nodes.label: Shared EncryptionService (AES-GCM)
nodes.rationale: Client-side AES-GCM encryption reused unchanged from the shared package; mobile only needed react-native-quick-crypto to make the Web Crypto surface available.

nodes.label: PasswordDetailSheet
nodes.rationale: Password masked by default with an eye toggle to reveal; URL opening guarded by isValidUrl() before Linking.openURL; footer padding from useSafeAreaInsets().bottom; max height 88% of screen.

nodes.label: PasswordFormScreen
nodes.rationale: Single component serving both add and edit routes via an optional passwordId prop. Layout is SafeAreaView -> KeyboardAvoidingView -> ScrollView, same as CardFormScreen.

nodes.label: PasswordListItem
nodes.rationale: Password is never revealed in the list (always dots) — reveal only happens in the detail sheet. Copy uses expo-clipboard and fires an onCopied callback so the parent screen owns the toast.

nodes.label: Cards Mobile UX Adaptation
nodes.rationale: Sidebar becomes horizontal chips, grid becomes a FlatList of compact rows, detail becomes an iOS pageSheet bottom sheet, and add/edit becomes a full-screen form because dialogs are poor on mobile. Category management moves to long-press on a chip.

nodes.label: react-native-quick-crypto Polyfill
nodes.rationale: CardEncryptionService depends on crypto.subtle (AES-GCM, PBKDF2), which RN 0.81/Hermes does not fully support. A JSI-based polyfill imported at the very top of app/_layout.tsx fixes this; viable because the project already uses native builds via expo run:ios rather than Expo Go.

nodes.label: Mobile Styling Conventions
nodes.rationale: bg-gray-50 screens, bg-white containers, rounded-2xl border-gray-200, three-level text hierarchy, indigo-600 accent, SafeAreaView on every screen, KeyboardAvoidingView with platform-conditional behavior on forms.

nodes.label: Rejection-Sampling Password Generator
nodes.rationale: Ports web's crypto.getRandomValues rejection-sampling approach (16 chars, upper+lower+digits+symbols) specifically to avoid modulo bias; works on RN because react-native-quick-crypto polyfills crypto globally.

nodes.label: Safe Area Inset Conventions
nodes.rationale: Always use useSafeAreaInsets() rather than hardcoding device spacing; a table maps each scenario (full screen, sheet footer, sheet ScrollView, FAB, top toast, keyboard form) to a specific padding formula.

nodes.label: Mobile-Only Offline Sync Architecture
nodes.rationale: Core lives in shared domain/sync with a platform-agnostic storage interface (no RN or DOM imports) so it is shared-ready even though only mobile uses it today.

nodes.label: SqliteSyncStorage (expo-sqlite)
nodes.rationale: Mobile implementation of the SyncStorage interface providing the expo-sqlite outbox and cache.

nodes.label: SyncEngine (push then pull)
nodes.rationale: Drains the outbox through repositories, then pulls a delta by updated_at and reseeds the React Query cache. The pull after push is what reconciles DB-trigger side effects and other devices' writes. 4xx drops the op and surfaces it; network errors retain it.

nodes.label: SyncQueue Outbox
nodes.rationale: Ordered outbox with enqueue/peek/markDone/markFailed and coalescing over PendingOp records carrying opId, type, entity, payload and baseUpdatedAt.

nodes.label: Mobile Grocery Module Structure
nodes.rationale: Components split into four groups (GroceryList, Main, Session, Invitation) with seven hooks; the grouping mirrors the four distinct user contexts rather than component type.

nodes.label: GroceryRealtimeService + Presence
nodes.rationale: Subscribes to Supabase postgres_changes and invalidates the React Query cache rather than patching it; presence channels track active shoppers with userId, displayName and onlineAt.

nodes.label: Grocery Digital Shopping Notebook Redesign
nodes.rationale: Sequenced data model -> offline sync -> UI because that order minimizes rework; web must keep compiling (shared domain is consumed by web/src/modules/grocery) but gets no UI redesign.

nodes.label: Offline Auth Hardening
nodes.rationale: AppState drives startAutoRefresh/stopAutoRefresh, and AuthContext treats network errors during token refresh as 'offline but still authed' — signing out only on an invalid-refresh-token, so airplane mode never logs the user out.

nodes.label: Client-Generated UUIDs on Create
nodes.rationale: Create DTOs accept an optional id so offline-created rows already have their final identity; dependent offline operations then need no id remapping when the queue drains.

nodes.label: Last-Write-Wins Conflict Resolution
nodes.rationale: LWW keyed on updated_at chosen over CRDTs for simplicity; Phase A exists partly to add the missing updated_at columns and triggers this strategy depends on.

nodes.label: Online-Only Operations Carve-Out
nodes.rationale: Invitations, member management and the findUserByEmail RPC are disabled offline with a hint, because they depend on server-side identity resolution that cannot be queued meaningfully.

nodes.label: Realtime Lifecycle in React Native
nodes.rationale: useGroceryRealtime's useEffect-with-cleanup works identically on RN; Supabase handles reconnection on app foreground automatically, so no extra AppState wiring was needed for realtime.

nodes.label: Web Path Aliases
nodes.rationale: Aliases must be declared in three places (tsconfig.app.json, vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts) because type-checking, bundling and testing each resolve modules independently.

nodes.label: rolldown-vite + SWC Build
nodes.rationale: Rolldown-based Vite fork with @vitejs/plugin-react-swc is chosen for build speed; a consequence is React Compiler cannot be used because it is incompatible with SWC.

nodes.label: cn() Component Styling Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every component spreads ComponentProps and merges an incoming className through cn() so callers can override Tailwind classes without prop drilling style objects.

nodes.label: TypeScript Path Aliases (scaffold)
nodes.rationale: Original scaffold mapped @core/* to src/modules/core/*, which is the origin of the later @core-to-shared naming mismatch.

nodes.label: @vitejs/plugin-react-swc
nodes.rationale: Uses SWC for Fast Refresh instead of Babel/oxc; chosen for speed at the cost of React Compiler compatibility.

nodes.label: Type-Aware ESLint Configuration
nodes.rationale: Recommended for production apps: replace tseslint recommended with recommendedTypeChecked/strictTypeChecked and point parserOptions.project at tsconfig.node.json and tsconfig.app.json.

nodes.label: @core Alias Points To src/modules/shared
nodes.rationale: Directory is named 'shared' but the alias kept the original 'core' name from the initial file-structure scaffold, creating a naming mismatch that must be remembered when adding modules.

nodes.label: React Compiler Incompatible With SWC
nodes.rationale: Tracked upstream in vitejs/vite-plugin-react issue 428; blocks adopting React Compiler while the SWC plugin is in use.

nodes.label: Paper Notebook UI Direction
nodes.rationale: Paper texture, ruled-line rows, handwritten display font, sticky-note notes, colored category chips, large touch targets and bottom-reachable actions for one-hand use; dark mode must preserve the notebook aesthetic.

nodes.label: Friends Screen (/friends route)
nodes.rationale: Four sections: add-by-email, incoming requests (accept/decline), outgoing (cancel), friends (remove). Expo Router auto-registers the route from the file path.

nodes.label: Grocery Header Friends Entry Point
nodes.rationale: People icon in GroceryHeader routing to /friends, with a red badge showing incomingRequests.length — the only surfacing of pending requests since friends have no realtime channel.

nodes.label: Broadsheet Token Palette
nodes.rationale: theme/notebook.ts is the single source mirrored into tailwind.config.js. A separate accentText (#006786) exists because the base cyan (#0088b0) only clears 3:1 contrast — fine for icons and fills, not for body copy.

nodes.label: Checkbox Reskin (highest leverage)
nodes.rationale: Done first because it propagates to every list and the session at once. Rounded square ~24x24, inkFaint 2px border unchecked, solid accent fill with white check when checked; the color prop's green branch is deleted since there is now one accent.

nodes.label: GroceryHeader Reskin
nodes.rationale: Serif 32 title with a #tag + count subline; the filled indigo Shop pill becomes a cyan outline or text button and the friends-badge red dot becomes cyan.

nodes.label: GroceryItemRow Reskin
nodes.rationale: Row backgrounds and rounded corners removed in favor of hairline separators on paper; the whole row becomes the check target with long-press still deleting, and the always-visible red trash icon is dropped because no red is allowed.

nodes.label: ItemRowContent Reskin
nodes.rationale: Checked state applies line-through and inkFaint to both name and meta; price uses tabular figures, right-aligned, keeping the peso sign.

nodes.label: Source Serif 4 App-Wide Type
nodes.rationale: Loaded via expo-font and set as the default Text family, replacing the system sans entirely. Emphasis and captions must use the true italic, never a synthesized oblique.

nodes.label: Notes-App Minimalist Direction
nodes.rationale: iOS-Notes calm in Broadsheet's newsprint voice: one flat paper ground (no cards, no shadows, no rounded containers), serif everywhere as the chrome, one accent color, one straight list, and generous air that must not be tightened.

nodes.label: Single Straight List (no tab split)
nodes.rationale: The To Get / Checked tab split is deleted; checked items stay in place struck through and greyed. Any surviving filter moves to a bottom-toolbar funnel icon rather than a top tab bar.

nodes.label: @himan/web Workspace
nodes.rationale: Web app is one workspace in an npm workspaces monorepo; npm install must run from the repo root so workspace symlinks to @himan/shared resolve correctly.

nodes.label: Supabase Client Initialization (initSupabase)
nodes.rationale: Dependency-injection init/get singleton lets the shared package stay platform-agnostic; web passes Vite env vars, mobile passes Expo env vars plus a SecureStore adapter.

nodes.label: Two-Level Folder Hierarchy (spec)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately capped at Folders to Notes (no nesting) to keep navigation and queries simple.

nodes.label: Three-Panel Notes Layout (spec)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors macOS Notes: folder list, notes list, and editor, so users get a familiar mental model without onboarding.

nodes.label: Simplified Clean Architecture (Hybrid)
nodes.rationale: Feature-sliced modules each carry their own domain/infrastructure/presentation triad instead of global layer folders, so a module can be deleted without touching the rest of the app.

nodes.label: VITE_ Prefixed Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: Vite only exposes variables prefixed with VITE_ to client code; they are validated at runtime in the shared supabase config so misconfiguration fails loudly at startup rather than at first query.

nodes.label: Shared Package Integration
nodes.rationale: Module infrastructure index.ts files re-export repositories/services from @himan/shared/<module> so internal web path aliases stay unchanged while domain code is shared cross-platform.

nodes.label: Module Independence
nodes.rationale: Modules must not reach into each other's internal structure; each is deletable without breaking others.

nodes.label: Barrel Export Public API (index.ts)
nodes.rationale: A single index.ts per module is the only sanctioned import surface, which is how module boundaries are actually enforced in a codebase with no compile-time visibility modifiers.

nodes.label: Use Case Driven Business Logic
nodes.rationale: Each business operation gets its own use case class (one file per use case) so behaviour is testable in isolation from UI and transport.

nodes.label: Debounced Auto-Save (spec)
nodes.rationale: Debouncing avoids one network write per keystroke while still removing an explicit save action from the user.

nodes.label: Tiptap Rich Text Editor (spec)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Lexical with StarterKit, Placeholder, Typography, Highlight, TaskList and TaskItem extensions; content stored as HTML.

nodes.label: NotesPage
nodes.rationale: Container that orchestrates the three panels and is mounted at /notes as a protected route.

nodes.label: useEditor
nodes.rationale: Wraps the Tiptap editor instance together with auto-save and formatting controls so components never touch the editor API directly.

nodes.label: Notes Supabase Schema (spec)
nodes.rationale: folders and notes tables with indexes, foreign keys and row-level security so user data is isolated at the database layer rather than in application code.

nodes.label: Migration 001_create_notes_tables.sql
nodes.rationale: Creates folders and notes tables plus RLS policies, indexes, updated_at triggers and a view exposing folders with note counts, so the note-count badge is a database concern rather than an N+1 client query.

nodes.label: notes Table
nodes.rationale: folder_id is nullable so a note can exist outside any folder, which is what makes the 'All Notes' default view possible.

nodes.label: Row Level Security On Notes Tables
nodes.norm_label: row level security on notes tables
nodes.rationale: Per-user CRUD policies enforce data isolation in the database, so a client bug cannot leak another user's notes.

nodes.label: Optimistic Updates (spec)
nodes.rationale: Local state is updated before the server confirms so the UI feels instant; errors surface through toast notifications.

nodes.label: Himan Personal Productivity Suite
nodes.rationale: Single monorepo hosting notes, passwords, file storage, credit cards, invoice generator, grocery lists and subscriptions so platform-specific apps can share one domain layer instead of duplicating business logic per platform.

nodes.label: npm Workspaces Monorepo Layout
nodes.rationale: workspaces = packages/*, web, mobile. Install must always run from root so workspace symlinks resolve; per-package installs break the shared package link.

nodes.label: @himan/shared Package (raw .ts subpath exports)
nodes.rationale: Exports raw .ts with no build step, consumed directly by Vite and Metro. tsconfig omits the DOM lib so browser-specific code fails at compile time; browser-only services (ThumbnailService, CompressionService, InvoicePDFService, LocalNotesStorage) therefore stay in web.

nodes.label: Himan Mobile README (stub)
nodes.rationale: Stale placeholder stating the RN/Expo setup is still to come, though the app is now implemented — contradicted by mobile/CLAUDE.md.

nodes.label: Module Boundary Rule (index.ts public API)
nodes.rationale: Inter-module imports must go through index.ts and never internal paths, so each module stays independently deletable.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Clean Architecture (domain/infrastructure/presentation)
nodes.rationale: Domain holds pure business logic with no framework imports; infrastructure imports domain only; presentation is platform-specific. Domain + infrastructure live in packages/shared so web and mobile reuse them; each platform re-exports via its own infrastructure/index.ts so internal path aliases never change.

nodes.label: Standalone @himan/shared/friends Module Decision
nodes.rationale: The friend graph is not grocery-specific, so it gets its own module for a clean boundary and reuse by web and future features; the shared layer stays UI-agnostic so web can adopt it later without rework.

nodes.label: Metro Shared-Package Resolution
nodes.rationale: Metro must remap .js to .ts for shared package internals and set resolver.unstable_enablePackageExports = true, because @himan/shared ships raw TypeScript with subpath exports and no build step.

nodes.label: Presentation-Only Reskin Boundary
nodes.rationale: hooks, contexts/SyncProvider, infrastructure and domain are explicitly untouched; collapse state, the session state machine and the invitations flow are unchanged. The redesign is scoped strictly to the presentation layer.

nodes.label: Invoice Generator Module (web)
nodes.rationale: PDF generation implemented with react-to-pdf; supports multi-currency and saved options so recurring invoice details can be reused.

nodes.label: Invoice Calculation Logic
nodes.rationale: subtotal = sum of non-blank item amounts; taxAmount = subtotal * tax/100; total = subtotal + taxAmount - discount + shipping. Tax is a percentage while discount and shipping are fixed amounts.

nodes.label: Multi-Currency Formatting (no conversion)
nodes.rationale: Currency selection changes only symbol and number formatting and never auto-converts amounts, avoiding dependence on an exchange-rate service and preventing silent mutation of entered figures. Default is PHP.

nodes.label: Invoice Generator UI Component (spec)
nodes.rationale: Built as a self-contained, client-only component to be dropped into an existing host project; routing, bundling and deployment are the host's responsibility.

nodes.label: Line Items Table
nodes.rationale: amount = unitCost x quantity, recomputed instantly, negative numbers rejected, unlimited rows.

nodes.label: Logo Upload With Preview
nodes.rationale: Restricted to JPG/JPEG/PNG under 5MB to keep the embedded PDF payload small.

nodes.label: Client-Side PDF Generation And Download
nodes.rationale: Validate, filter blanks, render a print-ready layout with no input fields visible, then download as Invoice-<invoice-number>.pdf via a browser-safe library (html2pdf, jsPDF or equivalent) so no backend is required.

nodes.label: Browser-Specific Services Stay In Web
nodes.rationale: ThumbnailService, CompressionService, InvoicePDFService and LocalNotesStorage depend on DOM/browser APIs, so they are excluded from the shared package whose tsconfig omits the DOM lib.

nodes.label: Blank Line Item Filtering
nodes.rationale: An item with empty description, or zero/empty unit cost, or zero/empty quantity is excluded from subtotal, from render and from the PDF; called out as critical because the artifact is a printed document where empty rows are visible defects.
